summary: The open AI model repository and developer inference ecosystem has matured significantly by 2026, with Hugging Face remaining the dominant hub hosting over 2 million models while specialized inference platforms like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow compete on speed and cost. The ecosystem is highly concentrated, with the top 200 most downloaded models comprising 49.6% of all downloads, and Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral leading cumulative download counts. Developers now have a rich set of alternatives spanning managed inference APIs, local runners, and serverless GPU platforms, reducing dependence on any single provider.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The largest open model repository and collaboration hub for AI, offering model hosting, datasets, Spaces for demos, and inference APIs routing to multiple backend providers
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models and limited inference; Pro at $9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; pay-per-use Inference Providers billed by token
features: 2 million+ models, datasets, and Spaces
Inference Providers tier routing to Together AI, Fireworks AI, DeepInfra, and others
Model cards, versioning, and community discussion
Fine-tuning and AutoTrain tools
Private model hosting and access controls
Leaderboards and evaluation benchmarks
Git-based model versioning with LFS support
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source contributors, and teams needing a one-stop hub for model discovery, sharing, and prototyping

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local model runner that lets developers download and serve open-source LLMs on their own hardware with a simple CLI and OpenAI-compatible REST API
platforms.model_count: 500+ curated models in the Ollama library
platforms.pricing: Completely free and open-source; costs are only your own hardware or compute
features: One-command model pull and run (e.g., ollama run llama3)
OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint
Supports Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, Gemma, Phi, and more
Modelfile system for custom system prompts and parameters
GPU acceleration on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, and AMD
Runs fully offline with no data leaving the machine
Active library of quantized GGUF models
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run models locally without cloud costs or data exposure

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Serverless cloud platform for running open-source AI models via a simple API, covering LLMs, image generation, audio, and video models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of compute time; no upfront cost; dedicated deployments available for production workloads at reserved pricing
features: Simplest API surface in the ecosystem — single predict() call
50,000+ models including Llama, Stable Diffusion, Whisper, and FLUX
Automatic scaling including scale-to-zero
Official model versions maintained by Replicate for top open models
Webhooks and async prediction support
Cog open-source tool for packaging custom models
Web UI for testing models without writing code
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting the fastest path to deploying open-source models in production without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: Low-cost LLM and embedding inference platform with an OpenAI-compatible API, plus fine-tuning and dedicated endpoint options for open-source models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; among the lowest published rates in the market (e.g., Llama 3.3 70B at ~$0.18/M input tokens as of early 2026); fine-tuning charged per token processed
features: OpenAI-compatible REST API for drop-in migration
Hosts Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Mixtral, and more
Dedicated endpoints for consistent latency SLAs
Fine-tuning API with LoRA support
Embeddings and reranking endpoints
Together Inference Engine optimized for high throughput
Used as a backend by Hugging Face Inference Providers
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers and teams running high-volume inference on open-source LLMs who need OpenAI API compatibility

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: High-throughput, low-latency inference platform for open-source LLMs and multimodal models, with a focus on production-grade speed and reliability
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing competitive with Together AI; volume discounts and reserved capacity available for enterprise
features: FireAttention custom inference kernel for best-in-class throughput
OpenAI-compatible API
Supports function calling and structured JSON output
Hosts Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mixtral, Firefunction models
Model fine-tuning and custom model deployment
Compound AI and multi-model routing support
Used as a backend by Hugging Face Inference Providers
platforms.best_for: Production teams needing fast, reliable open-model inference with low latency and high concurrency requirements

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: All-in-one AI model hosting and high-performance inference platform offering some of the fastest inference speeds alongside model deployment tools, rated top value in 2026
platforms.model_count: 100+ models across LLMs, image, and audio
platforms.pricing: Free tier with generous credits; pay-per-token for inference; competitive pricing with SiliconFlow highlighted as best-value option in 2026 comparisons
features: Ranked best overall value for AI model hosting in 2026
Faster inference speeds than many competitors on equivalent hardware
Hosts Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, and other top open models
OpenAI-compatible API
Both hosting and inference in a single platform
Strong performance on Chinese-origin models like Qwen and DeepSeek
Suitable for both prototyping and production workloads
platforms.best_for: Teams seeking the best cost-performance ratio for inference, especially those working with Qwen or DeepSeek model families

platforms.name: DeepInfra
platforms.purpose: Serverless inference API for open-source LLMs, embedding models, and image models with very competitive per-token pricing and broad model coverage
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; consistently among the cheapest providers for popular models; no minimum spend
features: OpenAI-compatible API
Broad coverage of Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, Whisper, and image models
Embeddings and text-to-image endpoints
Used as a backend by Hugging Face Inference Providers
Simple usage dashboard and API key management
Fast cold-start times on serverless endpoints
platforms.best_for: Budget-conscious developers needing access to a wide variety of open models at the lowest possible per-token cost

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified LLM inference gateway that routes requests across dozens of underlying providers — including Together AI, Fireworks AI, DeepInfra, and proprietary APIs — through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from open-source and proprietary providers
platforms.pricing: Pass-through pricing from underlying providers plus a small routing margin; some models offered free; pay-per-token
features: Single API key to access GPT-4o, Claude, Llama, DeepSeek, Gemini, and more
Automatic provider fallback and load balancing
Cost and latency comparison across providers in real time
Model context protocol and streaming support
Usage analytics and per-model spend tracking
Free tier with rate-limited access to many open models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want one API to experiment across many models and providers without managing multiple accounts and keys

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: Python-first serverless cloud compute platform for running AI inference, training, and fine-tuning jobs on GPUs with full code control and scale-to-zero billing
platforms.model_count: No fixed model library — run any model from Hugging Face or custom code
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of GPU time; free tier includes $30/month of compute credits; A100 and H100 instances available
features: Deploy any Hugging Face model or custom Python code as a serverless endpoint
Scale to zero when idle, scale to hundreds of GPUs under load
Fast container builds with cached layers for model weights
Full CUDA and PyTorch environment control
Supports vLLM, TGI, and custom inference servers
Web endpoints, scheduled jobs, and async queues
Ideal for custom fine-tuning pipelines
platforms.best_for: ML engineers who need full infrastructure control and want to run custom or fine-tuned models serverlessly without managing Kubernetes

platforms.name: Baseten
platforms.purpose: Production inference platform for deploying custom and open-source models as scalable API endpoints, with a focus on performance optimization and enterprise reliability
platforms.model_count: Pre-built Truss templates for 50+ popular models; deploy any custom model
platforms.pricing: Usage-based on GPU compute time; dedicated and autoscaling deployment options; enterprise contracts available
features: Truss open-source framework for packaging any model as an API
Pre-optimized deployments for Llama, Whisper, Stable Diffusion, and others
Autoscaling including scale-to-zero
High-throughput serving with TensorRT-LLM and vLLM backends
Secret management and private model storage
Performance-focused with sub-100ms cold starts on warm instances
Observability and logging built in
platforms.best_for: ML teams deploying custom or fine-tuned models to production who need performance optimization and enterprise-grade reliability

platforms.name: RunPod
platforms.purpose: GPU cloud marketplace offering raw GPU rental for AI inference, training, and fine-tuning, with both on-demand and spot instance pricing and a Serverless product for scale-to-zero deployments
platforms.model_count: Community hub with 100+ pre-configured templates; run any model on raw GPU
platforms.pricing: Spot GPUs from ~$0.20/hr; on-demand from ~$0.44/hr for A40; Serverless billed per compute unit consumed
features: Widest GPU selection including H100, A100, A40, RTX 4090, and older consumer GPUs
Serverless endpoints for scale-to-zero inference
One-click templates for Ollama, vLLM, ComfyUI, Automatic1111
Persistent storage volumes for model weights
Network volumes shared across pods for fast model loading
SSH and Jupyter access to raw GPU instances
Community and official templates for quick starts
platforms.best_for: Developers and researchers needing affordable raw GPU access for training, fine-tuning, or running large models that exceed consumer hardware limits

platforms.name: LM Studio
platforms.purpose: Desktop application for discovering, downloading, and running open-source LLMs locally with a chat UI and a built-in local inference server compatible with the OpenAI API
platforms.model_count: Searches and downloads from Hugging Face; access to tens of thousands of GGUF quantized models
platforms.pricing: Free for personal use; LM Studio Pro for commercial use
features: Graphical UI for browsing and downloading models from Hugging Face
Built-in chat interface for immediate model testing
Local server emulating the OpenAI API on localhost
Automatic hardware detection and model compatibility filtering
Supports GGUF quantized models via llama.cpp backend
Multi-model loading and context management
Available on macOS, Windows, and Linux
platforms.best_for: Non-technical users and developers who want a GUI-first experience for running local LLMs without using the command line
